extraTests.domain: All pile arrays n=1..4, ai=1..3, every label queried in reverse order (120 inputs); explicit worm-to-pile expansion.

183828739.reason: Correct pile intervals, but scans all n piles for every query without stopping; counted failure is TLE.

184004619.reason: Uses strict h<sl[g] rather than h<=sl[g], which misassigns boundary labels, but the recorded counted counterexample times out rather than completing a WA; cannot substitute another test without fresh evidence.

184067379.reason: Correct inclusive prefix-boundary search implemented by O(n*m) linear scanning; only TLE at counted test.

184515418.reason: Correct disjoint half-open pile intervals; O(n*m) nested scanning times out.

184516288.reason: Correct inclusive prefix sums and first-pile search; O(n*m) linear scanning times out.
